featured_reviews.name: Rahul Singh
featured_reviews.review_text: "Extremely disappointed with Apollo Pharmacy Gokuldham. From slow billing queues to a complete lack of basic hygiene in the store, everything is substandard. The pharmacists are ill-informed and don't even know how to process digital payments properly. This outlet is a disgrace to the Apollo brand name."

featured_reviews.name: Avinash Kannaujiya
featured_reviews.review_text:
I am extremely disappointed with my recent experience at this Apollo Pharmacy branch. While I expect a certain level of professionalism from a reputed healthcare chain, the service here was abysmal.

Specifically, I want to highlight the behavior of the supervisor, Avnish Yadav. His conduct was highly unprofessional and rude. He lacks basic customer service etiquette and has a very poor attitude toward patients and customers. A supervisor is supposed to solve problems, but his behavior only made the experience worse.

It is clear that there is a major issue with the management and staff training at this location. I would strongly advise others to avoid this branch until they address these behavioral issues and ensure their staff knows how to treat people with respect.

featured_reviews.name: Rahul Chauhan
featured_reviews.review_text:
Don't trust on Google reviews, People who had given 1 star they are Real customer but others are staff of the Apollo pharmacy. I've experienced such as cheating , misleading. They force to buy their 199 rs plan to get 15% cashback. My medicine cost around 13 thousand rupees. I got 20% instant discount on without paying extra charges. I have purchased 12445 rs medicine & purchased their 199 rs plan and paid full amount of medicine. They told me that I will receive 15% cashback but I didn't received single penny yet. I got scammed.
Such a pathetic experience.

I'll raise this issue with senior head, owner and CEO of the Apollo pharmacy. And also file a complaint in consumer court.
If I have option for zero star or negative star rating, I will do it. This is very bad pharmacy

featured_reviews.name: Sriparna Basu
featured_reviews.review_text: Possibly the worst experience at a chemist! The staff is rude, unwilling to sell medicines and hand-in-glove with the Apollo online medicine delivery service who pick up paid orders and get away with them without delivering! Think several times before approaching or ordering from this particular store, they’re selling medicines which are supposed to be life-saving but the staff is running their own agenda out of it! Beware!

featured_reviews.name: SANDEEP YADAVजी
featured_reviews.review_text: Best pharmacy ever...The night' staff is  knowledgeable, and also hilarious ... I'm pretty sure they're secretly stand-up comedians on the side! 😂💊

featured_reviews.name: Thakur Veer
featured_reviews.review_text: "I had a terrible experience at this Apollo Pharmacy branch. The staff is incredibly rude and seems completely uninterested in helping customers. They kept me waiting for a long time while they chatted among themselves, and when they finally attended to me, they acted like they were doing me a favor. Avoid this place if you value your time and respect."

featured_reviews.name: Veer Singh
featured_reviews.review_text: "This is easily the worst-managed pharmacy in the Gokuldham area. They never have basic medicines in stock, and their inventory management is a mess. I was told a medicine was available over the phone, but when I reached the store, they casually said it was out of stock. Highly unprofessional and unreliable for emergency needs."
